items.details: Clear the surrounding snipers while staying behind rooftop cover. Reposition onto the lower western roof when the exit becomes available. Keep a powerful weapon ready for the gunship; an RPG or explosive shotgun can remove it before you finish the ground escape. Leave room between Luis and nearby explosions.

details_i18n.en: Clear the surrounding snipers while staying behind rooftop cover. Reposition onto the lower western roof when the exit becomes available. Keep a powerful weapon ready for the gunship; an RPG or explosive shotgun can remove it before you finish the ground escape. Leave room between Luis and nearby explosions.
details_i18n.pt: Elimine os atiradores ao redor mantendo-se protegido no telhado. Reposicione-se no telhado inferior a oeste quando a saída ficar disponível. Reserve uma arma potente para o helicóptero de ataque; um RPG ou a espingarda explosiva pode derrubá-lo antes da fuga por terra. Mantenha distância entre Luis e as explosões próximas.

details_i18n.en: Use cover while destroying the marked shipments at Funland and collect the available health before retracing your route. During the airport approach, follow the route while Yusuf handles much of the pursuit. Accelerate alongside the jet’s rear-left boarding point; after the aircraft sequence, guide the parachute toward the final destination.
details_i18n.pt: Use cobertura ao destruir as cargas marcadas em Funland e recolha a saúde disponível antes de refazer o caminho. No trajeto ao aeroporto, siga a rota enquanto Yusuf cuida de boa parte da perseguição. Acelere junto ao ponto de embarque na traseira esquerda do jato; após o trecho na aeronave, guie o paraquedas até o destino final.

items.details: Start management in the staff room at Maisonette 9 during opening hours, 21:00–06:00. Follow surveillance and removal prompts until Dessie assigns VIP work. For Jackson, maneuver out of the photographers without running them over, then lose the pursuing bikes. Failed VIP work can return later; complete all eight different jobs, not eight repetitions.

details_i18n.en: Start management in the staff room at Maisonette 9 during opening hours, 21:00–06:00. Follow surveillance and removal prompts until Dessie assigns VIP work. For Jackson, maneuver out of the photographers without running them over, then lose the pursuing bikes. Failed VIP work can return later; complete all eight different jobs, not eight repetitions.
details_i18n.pt: Inicie a gestão na sala de funcionários do Maisonette 9 durante o expediente, das 21:00 às 06:00. Siga as instruções de vigilância e expulsão até Dessie designar o trabalho com VIPs. Com Jackson, saia do grupo de fotógrafos sem atropelá-los e despiste as motos. Um trabalho fracassado pode voltar depois; conclua os oito diferentes, não oito repetições.

items.details: Bring armor and suitable ammunition before starting a capsule marker. Identify whether the job requires a loose stash or a particular vehicle: destroying a required delivery vehicle will not help. Track successful jobs in Stats. Twenty-five satisfies native completion and Snow Queen; fifty is a separate weapon-reward target, not another ending prerequisite.

details_i18n.en: Bring armor and suitable ammunition before starting a capsule marker. Identify whether the job requires a loose stash or a particular vehicle: destroying a required delivery vehicle will not help. Track successful jobs in Stats. Twenty-five satisfies native completion and Snow Queen; fifty is a separate weapon-reward target, not another ending prerequisite.
details_i18n.pt: Leve colete e munição adequada antes de iniciar um marcador de cápsula. Identifique se o trabalho exige uma carga solta ou um veículo específico: destruir o veículo que precisa entregar não ajuda. Acompanhe os trabalhos concluídos em Stats. Vinte e cinco bastam para a conclusão nativa e Snow Queen; cinquenta são um objetivo separado de recompensa, não outro requisito para o final.

items.details: Triathlons unlock after This Ain’t Checkers. Save time by steering the parachute toward the boats, then follow every checkpoint through the water stage. At the beach transition, choose a car promptly. Use its replenishing nitro on clear straights rather than through sharp turns. Each of the three courses needs a first-place finish.

details_i18n.en: Triathlons unlock after This Ain’t Checkers. Save time by steering the parachute toward the boats, then follow every checkpoint through the water stage. At the beach transition, choose a car promptly. Use its replenishing nitro on clear straights rather than through sharp turns. Each of the three courses needs a first-place finish.
details_i18n.pt: Os triatlos são liberados após This Ain’t Checkers. Ganhe tempo guiando o paraquedas até os barcos e passe por todos os checkpoints na água. Na transição da praia, pegue um carro rapidamente. Use o nitro recarregável nas retas livres, não nas curvas fechadas. É preciso terminar em primeiro em cada um dos três percursos.

details_i18n.pt: Conclua a sequência completa, incluindo a coreografia em grupo, tanto no Maisonette 9 quanto no Hercules. Encha o medidor seguindo o ritmo, segure uma direção quando solicitado e use os comandos rítmicos exibidos durante as pausas. Continue após um pequeno erro: terminar com sucesso é melhor do que abandonar uma sequência ainda recuperável.

items.title: Win the L.C. Cage Fighters championship

items.description: Win all six rounds in one championship run.

description_i18n.en: Win all six rounds in one championship run.
description_i18n.pt: Vença as seis rodadas em uma disputa do campeonato.

items.details: The championship has six rounds of three opponents each. Continue between rounds rather than cashing out early. Later opponents carry weapons: time a dodge and counter to disarm them instead of trading hits. Health recovers partly between rounds, but acquired weapons do not carry into the next round, so repeat the defensive approach.

details_i18n.en: The championship has six rounds of three opponents each. Continue between rounds rather than cashing out early. Later opponents carry weapons: time a dodge and counter to disarm them instead of trading hits. Health recovers partly between rounds, but acquired weapons do not carry into the next round, so repeat the defensive approach.
details_i18n.pt: O campeonato tem seis rodadas com três adversários cada. Continue entre as rodadas em vez de encerrar antecipadamente. Os oponentes posteriores usam armas: esquive e contra-ataque no momento certo para desarmá-los, sem apenas trocar golpes. Parte da saúde se recupera entre rodadas, mas as armas obtidas não passam à seguinte; repita a abordagem defensiva.

items.title: Hit four golf flags for Four Play

description_i18n.en: Register four direct flag hits with golf balls.
description_i18n.pt: Registre quatro acertos diretos nas bandeiras com bolas de golfe.

items.details: Aim for the flag itself rather than merely placing the ball nearby. Start the backswing, then time the strike as the power indicator reaches the target marker. Adjust after watching the ball’s bounce. Four registered direct hits are cumulative, so they need not occur in one game.

details_i18n.en: Aim for the flag itself rather than merely placing the ball nearby. Start the backswing, then time the strike as the power indicator reaches the target marker. Adjust after watching the ball’s bounce. Four registered direct hits are cumulative, so they need not occur in one game.
details_i18n.pt: Mire na própria bandeira, não apenas perto dela. Inicie o movimento do taco e acerte quando o indicador de força alcançar a marca do alvo. Ajuste após observar o quique da bola. Os quatro acertos diretos registrados são cumulativos; não precisam ocorrer em uma única partida.

items.details: Equip a parachute before boarding a helicopter, climb to the flight ceiling and position over low, open terrain such as a beach. Jump and delay opening the parachute while watching the ground closely. Leave enough altitude to slow down and survive; opening immediately defeats the purpose of this separate trophy challenge.

details_i18n.en: Equip a parachute before boarding a helicopter, climb to the flight ceiling and position over low, open terrain such as a beach. Jump and delay opening the parachute while watching the ground closely. Leave enough altitude to slow down and survive; opening immediately defeats the purpose of this separate trophy challenge.
details_i18n.pt: Equipe um paraquedas antes de entrar no helicóptero, suba até o limite de altitude e posicione-se sobre terreno baixo e livre, como uma praia. Salte e adie a abertura observando o chão com atenção. Reserve altura para desacelerar e sobreviver; abrir imediatamente elimina o objetivo deste desafio separado de troféu.

items.details: After the ending, use the phone’s Missions menu to start fresh replays. Completed score criteria accumulate across separate successful runs, so a damage or accuracy attempt can be separate from the speed attempt. Cheats, taxi rides and restarting after failure invalidate scoring; if that happens, begin another fresh phone replay. Check the stored result before moving on.

details_i18n.en: After the ending, use the phone’s Missions menu to start fresh replays. Completed score criteria accumulate across separate successful runs, so a damage or accuracy attempt can be separate from the speed attempt. Cheats, taxi rides and restarting after failure invalidate scoring; if that happens, begin another fresh phone replay. Check the stored result before moving on.
details_i18n.pt: Após o final, use o menu Missions do telefone para iniciar novas repetições. Os critérios de pontuação cumpridos se acumulam entre tentativas bem-sucedidas; a tentativa de dano ou precisão pode ser separada da tentativa rápida. Trapaças, viagens de táxi e reinícios após falhar invalidam a pontuação; se isso acontecer, inicie outra repetição pelo telefone. Confira o resultado salvo antes de seguir.

items.details: Check this episode’s own statistic, not GTA IV’s base-game save. Native completion combines the campaign, eight distinct VIP jobs, all random-character returns, twenty-five Drug Wars, fifteen BASE jumps, three triathlon wins, fifty seagulls, the required games and seven friend activities. Mission scores of eighty or one hundred percent are additional trophy challenges, not requirements for this world-completion statistic.

details_i18n.en: Check this episode’s own statistic, not GTA IV’s base-game save. Native completion combines the campaign, eight distinct VIP jobs, all random-character returns, twenty-five Drug Wars, fifteen BASE jumps, three triathlon wins, fifty seagulls, the required games and seven friend activities. Mission scores of eighty or one hundred percent are additional trophy challenges, not requirements for this world-completion statistic.
details_i18n.pt: Confira a estatística do próprio episódio, não o salvamento do GTA IV básico. A conclusão nativa reúne campanha, oito trabalhos VIP diferentes, todos os retornos dos encontros aleatórios, vinte e cinco Drug Wars, quinze saltos BASE, três vitórias em triatlos, cinquenta gaivotas, os jogos exigidos e sete atividades com amigos. Pontuações de oitenta ou cem por cento nas missões são desafios extras de troféus, não requisitos dessa estatística de conclusão do mundo.
